def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half=[row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [a[r]+cw[r] for r in range(n)] + [ccw[r]+half[r] for r in range(n)]
